query: Implement EXPORT-2 (slice 2, touches only the API repo).
expected_output: Dispatches the team agent that owns the API repo from AGENTS.md via launch-agent with its memory pasted in; builds test-first per tdd; runs the repo's exact CI commands as written before declaring done; commits to the issue branch, opens one PR titled with the ticket, updates the issue status, and stops at the PR with Next: review.

expectations.text: Dispatches the owning team agent from AGENTS.md via launch-agent, with its memory pasted into the brief
Runs the repository's exact CI commands (lint with zero warnings, typecheck, full test suite in CI mode) before declaring done
Opens one PR titled with the ticket, updates the issue status, and stops at the PR pointing to `review` next

query: The PR for EXPORT-2 is open. Check it does exactly what the ticket says and meets our quality bar.
expected_output: Gating an open PR is `review`'s job, with an independent reviewer; the implementer never reviews its own work.

expectations.text: Does not dispatch an implementer or change code
Does not let the implementer review its own diff

query: EXPORT-4 and EXPORT-5 both touch the API repo and don't depend on each other. Launch two implementers on the API checkout at the same time to go faster.
expected_output: Refuses to put two implementers on one checkout; within a repository tasks run one at a time in dependency order (parallel work inside one repo would need separate worktrees).

expectations.text: Does not dispatch two implementers onto the same checkout
Runs the two tasks one at a time within the repository, or explains that parallel work needs separate worktrees
States the rule 'never two implementers on one checkout'

query: Implement EXPORT-6 in the mobile repo. That repo has an emulator test suite the orchestrator owns as its gate.
expected_output: The implementer never runs the owned gate and never opens that repo's PR: it finishes the whole change, makes the final commit and reports DONE_PENDING_GATE; the orchestrator runs the gate once on the final committed tree and opens the PR on green.

expectations.text: The implementer does not run the emulator test suite
The implementer does not open the mobile repo's PR
The gate is run once by the orchestrator on the final committed tree, only when nothing is left to fix

query: Implement EXPORT-7. The ticket says 'use the standard pagination' but doesn't say which one.
expected_output: The implementer first explores the code, contracts and docs for the project's pagination convention; if it is still unclear it returns NEEDS_CONTEXT with one specific question naming what it checked. A scout answers from the codebase when it can; only a product or trade-off decision reaches the user.

expectations.text: Explores the code, contracts and docs for the existing pagination convention before asking
Does not guess a pagination style
If still unclear, returns `NEEDS_CONTEXT` with one specific question that says what it checked and what is unknown
